<script>
(() => {
  const tipsRoot = document.querySelector('.tips'); const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tipcard .fire')]; if (!tipsRoot || !btns.length) return;
  let voter = null; try { voter = localStorage.getItem('bbt_voter'); if (!voter) { voter = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12)), (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); localStorage.setItem('bbt_voter', voter); } } catch (e) { voter = 'anon' + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 14); }
  const call = (body) => fetch(tipsRoot.dataset.endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ word: tipsRoot.dataset.word, voter, ...body }) }).then((r) => r.json());
  const paint = (b, n, on) => { b.querySelector('b').textContent = n; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false'); };
  call({ action: 'heat', tip_ids: btns.map((b) => Number(b.dataset.tip)) }).then((j) => { if (!j.ok) return; btns.forEach((b) => paint(b, j.heat[b.dataset.tip] || 0, (j.mine || []).includes(Number(b.dataset.tip)))); }).catch(() => {});
  btns.forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => { const on = b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true'; b.disabled = true; try { const j = await call({ action: 'vote', tip_id: Number(b.dataset.tip), on }); if (j.ok) paint(b, j.heat, j.on); } catch (e) {} b.disabled = false; });
})();
</script>
scripts.spill:
<script>
(() => {
  const f = document.getElementById('spillform'); if (!f) return;
  const ta = f.querySelector('textarea'), cnt = f.querySelector('.cnt'), msg = f.querySelector('.msg'), btn = f.querySelector('button');
  const say = (t, cls) => { msg.textContent = t; msg.className = 'msg ' + (cls || ''); };
  ta.addEventListener('input', () => { cnt.textContent = ta.value.length + ' / 1000'; });
  const ERR = { wrong_word: "That's not the league word.", too_short: 'Give us a little more than that.', too_long: 'Keep it under 1,000 characters.',
                slow_down: "The tip line is jammed. Try again in a bit." };
  f.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (ta.value.trim().length < 10) { say(ERR.too_short, 'err'); return; }
    btn.disabled = true; say('Sending…');
    try {
      const r = await fetch(f.dataset.endpoint, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ tip: ta.value, word: f.word.value, website: f.website.value }) });
      const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (j.ok) { f.reset(); cnt.textContent = '0 / 1000'; say("Got it. Watch next week's issue.", 'ok'); }
      else say(ERR[j.error] || "Couldn't send that. Try again.", 'err');
    } catch (_) { say("Couldn't send that. Check your connection and try again.", 'err'); }
    btn.disabled = false;
  });
})();
</script>
